sample_unit: LLM-generated Turkish patient education brochures (one per model)

links.outcome: Readability (Ateşman) and DISCERN reliability of Turkish LLM patient education brochures
links.effect: Readability scores ranged from 61.6 to 80.2 (mean 71.3 ± 6.9); DISCERN reliability scores ranged from 38.5 to 60.5, with only Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Gemini 2.0 Flash consistently patient-centered.
links.quote: Readability scores ranged from 61.6 to 80.2 (mean = 71.3 ± 6.9), with ChatGPT-4o and Qwen 2.5 generating the most accessible texts.

screen.reason: Evaluates 7 LLMs on readability (Ateşman) and quality/reliability (DISCERN) of zero-shot generated patient education leaflets for psoriasis/PsA in Turkish, without testing a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
